n6.vk.vergabe.ausschreibung: Open tender: construction starts only after the tender phase; in return there is no corruption risk, and markets, the EU and legitimacy all approve.

n6.neu.visionenSatz: Possible, but barely affordable: decades of construction, heavy debt, overruns as the rule and endless opposition. The reward is prestige, not a quick win.

n6.neu.artSatz.wunder: Unique, with a celebration and opponents; they change the country for good.
n6.neu.artSatz.grossprojekt: Bridges, railways, power plants: long construction, lasting benefit, debt and resistance.
n6.neu.artSatz.serie: A route links several sites and requires all of them to be well preserved.

n6.neu.artSatz.doktrin: One doctrine rules out the others and shapes what the armed forces prepare for.
